query: When does writing a body for HEAD, 204, or 304 synchronously throw?
candidate_pool: all held-out groups, old and new tagged excerpts

candidates.text:
# Node.js buffer

## Static method: `Buffer.concat(list[, totalLength])`

If `totalLength` is provided, it is coerced to an unsigned integer. If the combined length of the `Buffer`s in `list` exceeds `totalLength`, the result is truncated to `totalLength`.

# Node.js buffer

## Static method: `Buffer.concat(list[, totalLength])`

If `totalLength` is provided, it is coerced to an unsigned integer. If the combined length of the `Buffer`s in `list` exceeds `totalLength`, the result is truncated to `totalLength`. If the combined length of the `Buffer`s in `list` is less than `totalLength`, the remaining space is filled with zeros.

# Node.js buffer

## `buffer.constants.MAX_LENGTH`

On 64-bit architectures, this value currently is 2<sup>32</sup> (about 4 GiB).

# Node.js buffer

## `buffer.constants.MAX_LENGTH`

On 64-bit architectures, this value currently is 2<sup>53</sup> - 1 (about 8 PiB).

# Node.js http

## `response.write(chunk[, encoding][, callback])`

Writing to the body is not allowed when the request method or response status do not support content. If an attempt is made to write to the body for a HEAD request or as part of a `204` or `304`response, a synchronous `Error` with the code `ERR_HTTP_BODY_NOT_ALLOWED` is thrown.

# Node.js http

## `response.write(chunk[, encoding][, callback])`

If `rejectNonStandardBodyWrites` is set to true in `createServer` then writing to the body is not allowed when the request method or response status do not support content. If an attempt is made to write to the body for a HEAD request or as part of a `204` or `304`response, a synchronous `Error` with the code `ERR_HTTP_BODY_NOT_ALLOWED` is thrown.

# Node.js net

## `net.getDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout()`

Gets the current default value of the `autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout` option of [`socket.connect(options)`][]. The initial default value is `250`.

# Node.js net

## `net.getDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout()`

Gets the current default value of the `autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout` option of [`socket.connect(options)`][]. The initial default value is `250` or the value specified via the command line option `--network-family-autoselection-attempt-timeout`.
